why: Five gap-driven rounds closed the six scoped mechanisms with distinct origin families: adaptive graphs (MindSearch; STORM/Co-STORM), durable/replay state (OpenHands; LangGraph; Google; Microsoft; Anthropic), artifact coordination (Anthropic), interoperable provenance (W3C), hierarchical context (HiAgent), and failure memory (Reflexion; ExpeL). Targeted requeries mostly returned these anchors, surveys, or off-topic hits. The remaining load-bearing uncertainty is integration efficacy: no primary study tests this complete architecture on deep field surveys, so it requires an Aletheia-specific controlled A/B rather than more broad searching.
